decisions.statement: A container recipe is in a file beside the page.
A second image is a second page.
A path a recipe copies from is read from the folder the build is handed.
The folder a build is handed is the package the recipe sits in.
A recipe whose image is pushed names the repository it is pushed to.
A recipe nothing pushes names no repository.
Every recipe is composed by the group beside its page rather than written by hand.

definition: the steps a container image is built from
